title: Read WETH name on a pinned mainnet fork
prompt: Create solution.ts. Start a tevm memory client forked from Ethereum mainnet at exactly block 20,000,000 using RPC_URL and viem http transport. Simulate a call to WETH at 0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2 and read name(). Print exactly one JSON line shaped {"name":"Wrapped Ether","block":"20000000"}, with the values coming from the fork and client state.

title: Assert a known balance at a pinned block
prompt: Create solution.ts. Fork Ethereum mainnet at exactly block 20,000,000 with a tevm memory client and RPC_URL. Read the ETH balance of the beacon deposit contract 0x00000000219ab540356cBB839Cbe05303d7705Fa from the fork. Print exactly one JSON line {"balance":"<decimal bigint>","block":"20000000"}. The expected balance is the real pinned-state value, not a constant in your source.

title: Read a known storage slot at a pinned block
prompt: Create solution.ts. Use tevm to fork Ethereum mainnet at exactly block 20,000,000 via RPC_URL, then read raw storage slot zero of WETH at 0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2. Print exactly one JSON line {"slot":"<0x-prefixed 32-byte value>","block":"20000000"}. Read the slot through the tevm-backed client rather than making a standalone HTTP JSON-RPC request.

title: Compile Solidity source, deploy, and read
prompt: Create solution.ts. Read Counter.sol, compile it with the installed solc, deploy Counter to a fresh tevm memory client with constructor value 42, and call number() through tevm. Fail on compiler or tevm errors. Print exactly one JSON line {"value":"42","address":"<deployed address>"}.

title: Deploy source, write state, and read it back
prompt: Create solution.ts. Compile Counter.sol with solc, deploy it to a fresh tevm memory client with initial value 1, call set(9) as a state-changing tevm transaction, mine it when needed, then read number(). Print exactly one JSON line {"before":"1","after":"9","txHash":"<0x hash>"}. Surface and fail on any tevm errors.

title: Impersonate a token holder and move tokens
prompt: Create solution.ts. Compile and deploy Token.sol to tevm using holder 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000001000. Use tevm account state APIs to fund or initialize that address, then impersonate it by sending transfer(0x0000000000000000000000000000000000002000, 250) without a private key. Mine if needed and read both token balances. Print exactly one JSON line {"holder":"750","recipient":"250"}.

title: Move native value between impersonated accounts
prompt: Create solution.ts. Create a fresh tevm memory client. Set account 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000001000 to exactly 2 ether with tevmSetAccount, send exactly 1 ether from it to 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000002000 without a private key, and mine the transaction. Print one JSON line {"recipient":"1000000000000000000","senderBelowOneEther":<boolean>,"txHash":"<0x hash>"} using balances read after mining.

title: Mine blocks and assert block-number movement
prompt: Create solution.ts. Use a fresh tevm memory client, read its initial block number, mine exactly three blocks with the tevm mining action, then read the final block number. Print exactly one JSON line {"delta":"3","hashCount":3,"lastBlock":"<decimal>"}. Derive hashCount from the tevm mine result and delta from actual block numbers.

title: Mine a transaction and inspect its receipt
prompt: Create solution.ts. On a fresh tevm memory client, initialize and impersonate 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000001000, send a nonzero native-value transaction to 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000002000, mine one block, and fetch the real receipt. Print one JSON line {"status":"success","blockNumber":"<decimal>","gasUsed":"<positive decimal>","txHash":"<0x hash>"}.

title: Mine two transactions into one block
prompt: Create solution.ts. Fund and impersonate a tevm account, submit two native-value transactions with successive nonces before mining, mine one block, and fetch both receipts. Print one JSON line {"sameBlock":true,"ordered":true,"gasUsedPositive":true,"hashes":["<first>","<second>"]}. ordered must be based on transactionIndex values from the receipts.

title: Catch and surface a Solidity revert reason
prompt: Create solution.ts. Compile and deploy Counter.sol in tevm, call failWithReason(), catch the failure, and extract the Solidity revert reason rather than merely checking that an error exists. Print exactly one JSON line {"reverted":true,"reason":"blocked by eval"}. Use tevm's returned errors or thrown error information.

title: Decode a Solidity custom error
prompt: Create solution.ts. Compile and deploy Counter.sol in tevm, call restricted() from 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000001234, capture its Unauthorized(address) custom-error revert, and decode the error with the contract ABI. Print one JSON line {"errorName":"Unauthorized","caller":"0x0000000000000000000000000000000000001234"}. Do not infer the name only from a text match.

title: Trace a call and find SSTORE
prompt: Create solution.ts. Compile and deploy Counter.sol in tevm, encode set(88), call tevm's debug_traceCall with the default opcode tracer, and inspect the returned struct logs. Print one JSON line {"opcode":"SSTORE","index":<nonnegative integer>,"stepCount":<positive integer>} for the first SSTORE step. This must come from a tevm trace, not from disassembling bytecode.

title: Trace and extract a nested contract call
prompt: Create solution.ts. Compile Calls.sol and deploy both Callee and Caller to tevm. Trace Caller.callDouble(callee, 21) with debug_traceCall and callTracer, locate the nested call to Callee, and print one JSON line {"type":"CALL","to":"<callee address lowercase>","output":"42"}. Decode the nested output or execute result so output is decimal 42.

title: Import Solidity through the Vite plugin and typecheck
prompt: Implement a minimal Vite TypeScript project in this directory. Add vite.config.ts using vitePluginTevm from @tevm/vite-plugin. Add solution.ts that imports the named BundledCounter contract from ./BundledCounter.sol and statically accesses its typed abi and bytecode. Add any local declaration or config needed for tsc --noEmit while preserving the real plugin import at build time, plus a minimal index.html entry. Both tsc --noEmit and vite build must succeed. Do not replace the Solidity import with generated hard-coded metadata.

title: Write a passing Vitest test using tevm
prompt: Create solution.test.ts containing a real Vitest test. It must create a tevm memory client, set 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000001234 to 123456 wei through tevmSetAccount, read it back through the tevm-backed client, and assert exact bigint equality. The checker will run only this test with Vitest.

title: Export and import tevm state
prompt: Create solution.ts. Create two fresh tevm memory clients. In the first, set address 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000001234 to balance 77 and nonce 3. Export state using tevmDumpState, import it into the second using tevmLoadState, then read the account from the second client. Print one JSON line {"balance":"77","nonce":"3","stateEntries":<positive integer>} with stateEntries derived from the exported state.

title: Snapshot and revert local state
prompt: Create solution.ts. On a fresh tevm client set address 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000001234 to balance 5, take a snapshot through the tevm-supported anvil_snapshot or evm_snapshot request, mutate the balance to 10, revert with the matching tevm-supported RPC method, and read the restored balance. Print one JSON line {"before":"5","mutated":"10","restored":"5","reverted":true}.

title: Extract a changed slot from prestate trace diff
prompt: Create solution.ts. Compile and deploy Counter.sol with value 1 in tevm. Trace set(2) using debug_traceCall with prestateTracer and tracerConfig.diffMode true. Inspect the trace diff for the Counter address and storage slot zero. Print one JSON line {"before":"0x1","after":"0x2","address":"<counter address lowercase>"}. Normalize the slot values to short lowercase hex yourself.

title: Use createContract for typed calls
prompt: Create solution.ts. Define a small ABI and creation bytecode for a contract whose get() returns 42, build a tevm contract descriptor with createContract from tevm/contract, deploy it to a fresh tevm memory client, bind the returned address with withAddress, and call descriptor.read.get() through tevmContract. Print one JSON line {"value":"42","address":"<deployed address>"}. The descriptor must drive both deployment and read.

title: Decode an emitted event from execution logs
prompt: Create solution.ts. Compile and deploy Counter.sol in tevm, execute set(23), and decode the emitted ValueSet event from the tevm execution result or mined receipt using the ABI. Print one JSON line {"event":"ValueSet","value":"23","logCount":<positive integer>}. Do not print 23 unless it was decoded from a real log.

title: Relate receipt gas to block gas accounting
prompt: Create solution.ts. On a fresh tevm memory client, fund and impersonate an account, submit two plain native transfers before mining one block, then fetch the block with full transactions and both receipts. Print one JSON line {"transactions":2,"blockGasUsed":"<positive decimal>","receiptGasSum":"<positive decimal>","equal":true}. equal must compare the actual block gasUsed with the sum of actual receipt gasUsed.
